game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Rune Circle, a circle of glowing runes: the relic hunter must hold off rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Slice Slicer: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Rune Circle: a circle of glowing runes
core_gameplay_loop: In Rune Circle, repeat each round: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group. Then check slice_ok and advance.
player_objective: Protect the sealed archway from rune wisps in Rune Circle: keep slice_ok above zero until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 3 (intro tier): Slice Slicer
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 7, Level 3, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
